evals.prompt: Walk me through how an order changes as it moves through checkout, payment and fulfillment, so I can see its status and totals at each step.
Make an HTML page that follows one webhook payload from the provider through our signature check, parser and router, showing what the payload looks like after each stage.
Show how a user record changes as it moves through signup: the form, email verification, profile creation and the welcome sequence. I want to see the record at every stage.
Build an explainer that traces one event through our enrichment pipeline and shows the event's fields growing at each hop, from the raw click to the warehouse row.
Explain our refund flow by following a single refund request through review, approval and payout, showing the request's data after each step.
Make an explorable architecture page of our billing services, with groups for ingest, processing and storage, where I can click a service to read its runbook notes.
Draw a flowchart of our deploy approval process with decisions, a rollback loop and a subprocess for the security review. I only need the structure.
Build an HTML map of the 30 services behind the webhook router so I can pan, zoom and see which services call which.
Create a pipeline overview page with stage lanes from intake to delivery, showing the jobs in each lane and how they connect. No example data is needed.
